scope: Read-only audit of loader files copied by the emulator owner from the existing QEMU fixture
result: Effective cached and USB loader branches confirm no automatic retry for an unchanged populated mod cache; cold-boot candidate recovery remains untested

copied_files.role: Firmware entry loader; can chain to a USB or cached deck loader
EP147 reads the persistent preload environment before the loader reviews current USB selection
Cached effective loader available even when the mods USB is absent
USB effective loader; byte-identical to the cached copy and workstation published 1.2.3 loader

control_flow_facts.fact: With no selected USB, stage_deck can copy the persistent cached deck scripts into the temporary execution directory
chain hands execution to the available deck loader after syntax and switch checks; a successful chained execution terminates the firmware path
No selected mods USB produces an empty desired preload
An unchanged desired preload and cached bytes return without writing or restarting; community initializer refusal does not itself trigger retry
Changed desired state is written to the persistent preload environment for a later application start
A nonempty cached HAVE suppresses automatic restart unless a supported forced apply, uninstall or mods.off request exists; missing USB alone is not such a request
The post-start path manages pending metadata and media reannouncement; it does not retry a refused community mod initializer

source_comparison.difference: The actual firmware entry and drop-in differ from the inspected koi checkout even after line-ending normalization. Following the chain identifies byte-identical cached and USB 1.2.3 effective loaders with the same relevant no-retry branches.
source_comparison.execution_caveat: A future cold-boot trace must show the actual selected chain. If chaining fails, the older firmware fallback has different restart handling and must be assessed separately.

candidate_implications.negative_boot: Cached executable mapping can occur before missing-USB selection is processed. The candidate must refuse initialization before hooks, workers and other effects through the supported actual-USB assets service.
candidate_implications.positive_mount_timing: The same early guard can refuse when a valid USB is not mounted yet. These effective loaders provide no automatic same-set initializer retry, so positive normal startup is a required measured case.
candidate_implications.positive_acceptance: Supported automatic convergence may pass if evidenced, with the first initializer outcome and all restart causes recorded. Manual Reload, an agent restart, crash recovery or another reboot cannot rescue the positive boot.
candidate_implications.library_mapping: Core may retain a refused library mapped. Mapping alone neither proves active candidate hooks nor constitutes a recovery failure.
